instruction: A clean studio photograph captured in a medium shot at eye-level. In a minimalist indoor studio with a plain off-white background, three women celebrate together. On the left, the Caucasian woman in a black blazer (R3) stands facing right, smiling as she raises her right hand to high-five. In the center, the Black woman in a white button-up shirt and black skirt (R1) faces forward with a joyful smile, raising both hands to high-five her colleagues. On the right, the East Asian woman in a white collarless shirt and black pants (R2) stands facing left, smiling as she raises her left hand to complete the high-five. The scene is lit with bright, soft, even studio lighting.
elements: R1 is the central participant raising both hands to high-five both colleagues
R3 raises her right hand to high-five R1
R2 raises her left hand to complete a high-five with R1
R2 and R3 act as the two colleague partners high-fiving R1
the celebration takes place in a minimalist indoor studio with a plain off-white background
